steps.body: A near double is one step from a double: 6 + 7 is double 6, plus one more.
steps.narration: A near double is one step from a double: 6 + 7 is double 6, plus one more.

widget.prompt: Start at 12 (double 6) and hop forward 1 to find 6 + 7.

commonLandings.feedback: That hops backward. 6 + 7 is one MORE than double 6, not one less.

widget.missFeedback: Start at 12 and make 1 hop right, one number at a time.
widget.successFeedback: Double 6 is 12, and one more makes 13 — that is 6 + 7.

predict.reveal: 7 is one more than 6, so the total is one more than double 6: 13.
